question_text: Will the Associated Press (AP) call the 2025 New Jersey gubernatorial election before 9:30 PM ET?
resolution_criteria:
If the Associated Press (AP) makes its first definitive call of a winner for 2025 New Jersey gubernatorial election before 9:30 PM ET on Nov 4, 2025, then the market resolves to Yes.
The call must be an explicit declaration that a candidate, party, or option has won, will win, is projected to win, or equivalent clear language indicating the outlet has determined the winner. The call must appear on one of the outlet's primary platforms (main website, television broadcast, or official social media if that is their primary medium) and not be prefaced with qualifiers suggesting uncertainty such as "appears to," "likely to," "probably," or "may have." The relevant time is when the call first becomes publicly visible on the outlet's platform, not when it may have been written, decided internally, or prepared for publication. If the call is later retracted, the market nonetheless resolves to Yes based on the initial call time. Preliminary exit polls, reporting of other outlets' calls, conditional statements, opinion pieces, and technical glitches do not qualify as definitive calls.

Gov. Phil Murphy , the outgoing, term-limited Democrat, signed a package of voting reform laws in 2022 , including a provision allowing mail-in ballots to be counted up to five days before Election Day in the state. The change followed Murphy’s narrow 2021 re-election victory over Ciattarelli, which wasn’t called until the day after the election due to the slow pace of mail-in ballot processing. Ciattarelli led in the initial vote count that election night, but Murphy pulled ahead by morning as more ballots were ... The swift result was aided by the reforms allowing earlier counting that Murphy signed into law. “If there was a single election observation more than any other, across party lines, it’s how quick the count was,” Micah Rasmussen, director of the Rebovich Institute for New Jersey Politics, said in June.
